system.description: When you or an ally spends or loses HP to one of your Skills or spells, reduce the amount by (SL × 2), to a minimum of half — then they shake one status effect or end one Scene-duration spell on them. Also +(SL) to butchering, surgery and wound-treatment Checks (never against Defense or Magic Defense).
